openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: status code range example
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /range:
    get:
      operationId: rangeOnly
      responses:
        '2XX':
          description: success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: string
                example: "ok"
  /notFound:
    get:
      operationId: notFoundRange
      responses:
        '4XX':
          description: client error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  message:
                    type: string
                required:
                  - message
  /exactAndRange:
    get:
      operationId: exactAndRange
      responses:
        '200':
          description: exact success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  exact:
                    type: string
                required:
                  - exact
                additionalProperties: false
        '2XX':
          description: range success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  range:
                    type: string
                required:
                  - range
                additionalProperties: false

openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: lowercase status code range example
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /range:
    get:
      operationId: lowercaseRangeOnly
      responses:
        # Non-conformant lowercase range key; the generator accepts it, so the validator
        # must match it case-insensitively against the "2XX" bucket.
        '2xx':
          description: success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: string
                example: "ok"
